problems: Third pass (17 Oct): compiled each regional prosecutor office's own Form No. 1 annual (December, cumulative Jan-Dec) report from data.gov.ua. 19 of 27 regions covered with gaps in years: no Form 1 datasets on data.gov.ua from the Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Kherson, Mykolaiv or Poltava oblast prosecutors; Odesa 2022-2025 and Lviv 2025 files link to od.gp.gov.ua / lviv.gp.gov.ua which return HTTP 403; Dnipropetrovsk 2024 December file not published (monthly files stop before December); other missing years had no December file in the dataset. Crimea/Sevastopol: only 2021 (separate files for each); the 2020 'ARC' file is actually Form 2 and was not used. Cherkasy dataset includes a December 2013 report, kept as published. Where an office published the same December report twice, values were identical and one copy was used. Raw files in raw/oblast/ with _manifest.json (resource name, dataset, URL). Earlier problems: The Prosecutor General Form 1 files checked (raw/forma-1-gruden-2025.xlsx and the 103 xlsx files in forma_1.zip from the JSON dataset, deleted after checking) are national totals only. Regional figures exist only as separate datasets published by individual oblast prosecutor offices, in differing formats and with incomplete coverage of oblasts and years; they were not compiled. Wartime coverage of occupied areas is also incomplete in the source. | Retry 17 Oct: (1) State Statistics Service SDG 16.1.1 and 16.1.2 datasets on data.gov.ua (CC BY; Prosecutor General data: offences under Arts 115-118 and 121 2015-2023, and victims of intentional homicide incl. attempts by sex/minors) were downloaded to raw/ukrstat/ but are national totals only. (2) Prosecutor General Form 1 ARCHIVE dataset (59 monthly ODS files 2018-2020) checked: sheets are national ('по державі'), no oblast rows. (3) ukrstat.gov.ua does not connect from the shell; gp.gov.ua returns HTTP 403; web.archive.org unreachable from the shell and blocked for WebFetch. (4) Eurostat causes-of-death and crime tables do not cover Ukraine. (5) data.gov.ua searches for regional homicide tables ('умисні вбивства за регіонами', '16.1.1 регіонами', 'вбивств областями') returned only national or single-oblast prosecutor datasets.
